grammarExplanationEnglish: Want + object + to + base verb expresses what someone wants another person to do. Nearly + past verb describes something that almost happened. Would + base verb expresses an imagined choice.
grammarExplanationFrench: Want + complément + to + base verbale exprime ce que l’on veut qu’une personne fasse. Nearly + verbe au passé décrit ce qui a failli se passer. Would + base verbale exprime un choix imaginé.
